cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate #2 is the stronger route, buffered by Cocamide MEA #3, early Glycerin #4, Cocamidopropyl Betaine #5 and Coco-Betaine #17; the second anionic, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate #7, is a mild amino-acid surfactant that buffers rather than reinforces. No reset intent.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: two anionic routes; olefin sulfonate is high-detergency

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - Glycerin #4, pearlizing Glycol Distearate #6, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter #10, PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate #12, Sodium Hyaluronate #14, and late cationics (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #19, Polyquaternium-7 #21). No silicone; lipid after Parfum #8.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (shea #10 after Parfum, two late cationics), persistence low (no silicone/film), resetCapacity moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: shea butter + two cationics could interact into bounded residue
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: no meaningfully persistent system at a prominent position

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: 'Feuchtigkeitsauffüllendes Shampoo', '5 % Feuchtigkeitskomplex mit Hyaluron und Shea-Fettsäuren', 72 h moisture; verdict moisture_supported - humectant cluster (Glycerin #4, Sodium Hyaluronate #14, Propylene Glycol #18) plus emollient/deposition support (Glycol Distearate #6, Shea #10, PEG-55 PG Oleate #12, cationics #19/#21). 'Locken' is hair_texture (T2), not a focus.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Single dominant moisture claim in name + moisture_supported formula -> moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Curl definition/'gebändigt' are outcomes of the same conditioning route (F2) and texture, not a focus.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid #23 alone does not upgrade (§11).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T2: curl claims ignored. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY: application to 'Kopfhaut in den Ansatz' is a direction, not an E2 claim.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong -> regular (no reset usage, no clarifying focus) -> no change, no flag.

uncertainties: §4: no anchor for olefin-sulfonate + sarcosinate sulfate-free systems; resolved moderate by analogy with C1 (neighbor strong).
neighboringAlternative for W low is discretionary; recording 'moderate' mechanically raises a fine T4 flag, recording 'none' does not. The standard gives no criterion for when 'none' is allowed.
